lines.text: Many learners say: She is taller from me.
Better: She is taller than me.
Than! He is older than me.

native.tip: نقول «أطول مني» بحرف من، أما في الإنجليزية فنستخدم than: “She is taller than me.” وليس “She is taller from me.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “She is taller from me.” 😅 نقول «أطول مني» بحرف من، أما في الإنجليزية فنستخدم than، فالجملة الصحيحة “She is taller than me.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.tip: In Arabic we say «أطول مني» with «من», but in English we use than: “She is taller than me.” not “She is taller from me.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “She is taller from me.” 😅 In Arabic we say «أطول مني» with «من», but in English we use than, so the right sentence is “She is taller than me.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
